title: Delay Interest Day Count by Campus on Entrance Fee Agreement Refunds
content:
**Delay interest.** A refund under an **Entrance Fee Agreement** paid after its refund due date carries delay interest on the refundable amount, figured at the campus rate plus the outstanding step for the interest days counted, and added to the refundable amount before the payment is rounded to the cent half up.

**Day count.** The day count of the delay interest follows the campus: at Larkspur at Brookfield the interest is the refundable amount times the combined rate times the interest days counted divided by 365; at Larkspur at Harbor View it is the refundable amount times the combined rate divided by 12 for each whole month from the due date to the payment date; at any other campus it is the refundable amount times the combined rate times the interest days counted divided by 360; in every case the interest is rounded to the cent half up.

**Effect on the balance.** An estate refund closes the agreement when it is paid; any delay interest paid with it is Larkspur's own money and leaves the refundable balance below 0.00 by the amount of that interest.

The combined rate is the campus rate and the outstanding step added together, in percent a year.

## Campus table

| Campus | Interest |
|---|---|
| Larkspur at Brookfield | Refundable amount, multiplied by the combined rate, multiplied by the interest days counted, divided by 365 |
| Larkspur at Harbor View | Refundable amount, multiplied by the combined rate, divided by 12, multiplied by the whole months from the due date to the payment date |
| Larkspur at Willow Creek | Refundable amount, multiplied by the combined rate, multiplied by the interest days counted, divided by 360 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical refundable amount 200214.00)

| Campus | Inputs taken as given | Interest | Payment |
|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur at Brookfield | 8.5 percent, 100 interest days counted | 4662.52 | 204876.52 |
| Larkspur at Harbor View | 9.25 percent, 3 whole months | 4629.95 | 204843.95 |
| Larkspur at Willow Creek | 0.25 percent, 100 interest days counted | 139.04 | 200353.04 |

After the Brookfield payment of 204876.52 the refundable balance of the agreement stands at -4662.52, the delay interest paid.
